title: Absolute and lung volume-normalized deep learning-derived pulmonary vascular measures in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: distinct clinical associations and the role of lung volume in prognosis.
summary: Dual-center retrospective study of 118 IPF patients linking a DL-derived pulmonary vascular measure to severity and mortality, with DL CT quantification as the enabling AI role and a distinct normalization finding.
ai_technology: Deep-learning segmentation of CT images quantifies absolute and lung-volume-normalized pulmonary vascular measures in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A dual-center retrospective cohort of 118 patients links the derived measures to disease severity and mortality; association does not establish causation or clinical benefit.
evidence.unknown: Primary Methods/Results establish the cohort or experiment, comparison and stated validation limits.
